description:
## Dev2 Patchset - 29 New Patches

### AnalyticsDisablePatch (+9)
- Firebase Analytics disable
- MoTracing (distributed tracing) disable
- MEStatistics (XEngine media engine) disable
- Device ID expansion (IMEI, Android ID, Google Advertising ID)
- Network Metrics tracking disable
- Push Notification Statistics disable
- MediaLog/Battery Metrics disable
- MoLive APM (FPS/CPU/temperature) disable
- DNS SLA Logging disable

### PrivacyControlsPatch (+3)
- Contact Access Block (READ_CONTACTS)
- Location Privacy (profile hideLocation)
- Privacy Settings Force Enable (hideContacts, hideMutualContacts, hideSchool)

### PremiumUnlockPatch (+1)
- Live Streaming Permission Controls (canStartLive, canUseMaskMode, canVoiceLive)

### DialogCleanupPatch (+2)
- VIP Upgrade Popup suppression
- Dislike Who Liked Me popup suppression

### UiCleanupPatch (+11)
- Privilege Enhanced Promotion Banner
- Profile Thin Popup
- Super Like Banner
- Compliment Received Banner
- Operation Banner
- New User Special Like Banner
- Profile Fake View
- Super Like/Undo Guide Card
- Boost Guide Card
- City Top Greet Dialog
- Multi Super Like Push Bubble

### LiveStreamingPatch (+3)
- Chat Rate Limiting removal
- Voice Game Joining enable
- PK Battle All-Day enable

**Total: 80 patches across 7 patchsets**
